top_signals.title: Commission disburses €7.9 billion to strengthen Ukraine's financial stability and advance reform efforts
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 20 Nov 2026 Today, the European Commission has released €7.9 billion to Ukraine to support financing needs and maintain the functioning of the country's public administration, as it continues to defend itself against Russia's war of aggression. This is the largest single disbursement to Ukraine made by the EU under the Ukraine Facility.
